interpretation: Proceed with the simple fixed Glass-center measurement target for the next offline challenger. This interprets the user preference for consistent comparison and implementation simplicity in the preceding choice, not acceptance of current detector accuracy.

rule.location: existing Recipe GlassGeometry.ellipse.center_x, rounded once to nearest native source pixel with half ties toward positive X
rule.measurement: Only an independently identified current-frame boundary at that column may supply the role height. Preserve its exact measured geometry; no visible-side median, x relocation, interpolation or carried coordinate.
rule.unavailable: No eligible observation or ambiguous alternatives at the fixed column leave the affected role UNKNOWN.
rule.context: Surrounding image and temporal context remain available to identify the physical boundary; this is not a single-column-only detector.
rule.roles: Oil and Foam remain independently selected and available.
rule.conversion: Reuse existing GlassGeometry.level_px_from_zero and level_mm_from_zero after eligible same-frame Y; no report-side repair.
rule.ui: No new user setting; reuse current Glass center.
rule.scope: Offline design and comparison first; existing runtime output and W3 original-candidate-Y contract remain unchanged until a validated candidate is integrated.
